title: Kohl's Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2026 Financial Results
summary: Kohl’s Corporation (NYSE: KSS) today reported results for the first quarter ended May 2, 2026. Net sales decreased 1.7% and comparable sales decreased 1.1% Gross margin increased 4 basis points Diluted loss per share of ($0.13) Affirms full year 2026 financial outlook Michael Bender, Kohl’s Chief Executive Officer, said “We are pleased with our start to 2026. Our key initiatives continue to drive progressive improvements to the business, resulting in our best comparable sales performance in over four years. In addition, we continue to manage the business with great discipline leading to strong expense management, cleaner inventories, and an improved balance sheet.” “Moving forward, we remain committed to delivering more value and a better experience to our customers. I would like to extend my sincere gratitude to all of our Kohl’s associates for their dedication and determination to execute against our initiatives,” Bender continued.
